fact: The DGI's SISIC is deployed in Niamey, eight regional capitals and four departments, with a goal of 80% coverage by 31 December 2023, and the DGI wants all large and medium taxpayers to adopt online filing.
title: Avis d'appel d'offres : Recrutement d'un.e expert.e national.e en système et technologie de l'information dans les administrations fiscales à Niamey, Niger.
